agents.name: gentle-orchestrator
agents.role: SDD orchestrator: coordinates sub-agents, never does the work inline

agents.name: jd-judge-a
agents.role: Judgment Day blind judge A (read-only adversarial review)

agents.name: jd-judge-b
agents.role: Judgment Day blind judge B (read-only adversarial review)

agents.name: sdd-apply
agents.role: SDD implementation by task batches (apply-progress merge)

agents.name: jd-fix-agent
agents.role: Surgical fix agent for confirmed judgment-day findings

agents.name: review-risk
agents.role: R1 risk lens (security, permissions, data exposure, dependencies)

agents.name: review-readability
agents.role: R2 readability lens (naming, structure, maintainability)

agents.name: review-reliability
agents.role: R3 reliability lens (tests, contracts, determinism, regressions)

agents.name: review-resilience
agents.role: R4 resilience lens (fallbacks, retry, rollback, observability)

agents.name: review-refuter
agents.role: Adversarial refuter of severe review findings (read-only)

agents.name: review-validator
agents.role: Final read-only validation gate before any done claim

agents.name: sdd-init
agents.role: SDD bootstrap: stack detection, testing capabilities, persistence

agents.name: sdd-explore
agents.role: SDD exploration before committing to a change

agents.name: sdd-propose
agents.role: SDD change proposal: intent, scope, approach

agents.name: sdd-spec
agents.role: SDD delta specs with requirements and scenarios

agents.name: sdd-design
agents.role: SDD technical design and architecture approach

agents.name: sdd-tasks
agents.role: SDD task breakdown with review workload forecast

agents.name: sdd-verify
agents.role: SDD verification against specs with compliance evidence

agents.name: sdd-archive
agents.role: SDD close: sync delta specs and archive the change

agents.name: sdd-onboard
agents.role: Interactive SDD walkthrough on the real codebase (runs inline, not delegated)
